skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of entrepreneurship, including business opportunities, idea generation, and business planning.
Develop skills in creating and executing business plans.
Learn the fundamentals of business management and leadership.
Enhance critical thinking and problem-solving skills in a business context.
Develop effective communication skills for business presentations and negotiations.
Foster self-directed learning and adaptability in various work environments.
Understand ethical responsibilities and social accountability in business.
